seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded 22 rooms and 25 bookings for aldgate-flats property via timeline API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 120 tested Booking Timeline (Gantt-style Calendar). Navigation: Login -> click 'Calendar' in left sidebar. The calendar shows 22 rooms across 6 room types (Standard Double, Deluxe King, Family Suite, Superior Twin, Executive Suite, Standard Room) with 25 bookings. Features: date navigation (7d/14d/30d views, prev/next, today, date picker), search by guest name, collapsible room type groups, color-coded booking bars (amber=pending, blue=confirmed, green=checked_in, grey=checked_out, red=no_show). Click any booking bar to open detail slide-over with guest info, accommodation, folio, and quick actions (Check In/Out, No Show, Cancel). Quick actions update status in real-time.
